items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Willie Paggio and Ones Trapania and myself. ... The first man brought me on a street parade.

ctx.x: Yeah. Willie Paggio and Ones Trapania and myself. I think they had manual parades out that day. As long as we left a hall they called the New Hall on the street. They called North Durbin Street. It was many years ago. The first man brought me on a street parade.
How did you play in the old days in the dance bands? As much as you're playing today, the same sort of stuff?
